name: H1.4 linker histone, cluster member

function.text: H1-4 encodes histone H1.4. Annotated molecular activities include structural constituent of chromatin and chromatin DNA binding. It participates in chromosome condensation and nucleosome assembly.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to syndromic intellectual disability (autosomal dominant); Rahman syndrome (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
